This session is already live-dev. The selected route is $cortex:orchestrator. Use Cortex MCP tools for ledger operations and orchestration evidence. Native collaboration/subagents are allowed and required for worker dispatch and report ownership under the orchestrator contract. Do not run shell commands, inspect source, modify files, start nested live-dev, or start nested tmux. Derive every Cortex call solely from the tools' advertised schemas and descriptions. Exercise exact caller idempotency, the canonical current user-decision contract without deprecated aliases, creation of one bounded delegation, canonical incremental report assembly, and both report-metadata and authorized report-body reads. Make exactly one task-creation request and require exactly one non-replayed success for it. Never repeat or replay any successful mutation; only an explicitly transport-ambiguous result may be retried, and only when the advertised retry contract authorizes an exact retry. If any mutation is repeated, do not emit the success sentinel. Dispatch one bounded native worker and use its owned report. Return exactly CORTEX_LIVE_TOOLS_OK only after the live calls succeed and no mutation was repeated; otherwise return a sanitized tool error.

This is the stabilization example only. Every real task must supply a prompt describing its own changes and the live calls it needs to verify.
